# Psalm 148 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 148:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-he-established-them to-forever and-ever; a-decree he-gave and-not it-will-pass-away.
- **LOGOS:** And he established them forever and ever; he gave a decree, and it shall not pass away.
- **PNEUMA:** He established them forever — he issued a decree that will never be revoked.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
